overview: 本期共收录 12 篇论文。研究方向主要集中在金融经济学（6 篇）、风险管理与衍生品（2 篇）、国际贸易（2 篇）。方法上以均衡模型、数值模拟为主。来源分布：arXiv（7 篇）、OpenAlex（3 篇）、Semantic Scholar（2 篇）。其中 1 篇命中顶级期刊白名单。

papers.title: Striking a Bargain: Narrative Identification of Wage Bargaining Shocks
papers.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  Wage markup shocks, an important driver of business cycles, are hard to pin down. We quantify the importance of exogenous variation in wage bargaining power, one source of those shocks, from German minimum wage introduction episodes and strikes. This disciplines the impulse responses of unemployment and output, and sharpens inference for other variables, which behave consistently with predictions from search‐and‐matching models. We find that wage bargaining shocks meaningfully contribute to aggregate fluctuations in unemployment and inflation, exhibit substantial pass‐through to prices, and imply plausible dynamics for the vacancy rate, firms' profits, and the labor share.
papers.summary_zh:
【劳动经济学】摘要  
工资加成冲击是影响商业周期的重要因素，但其具体来源难以确定。我们通过分析德国最低工资制度的实施以及罢工事件，量化了工资议价能力外部变化（这些冲击的其中一个来源）的重要性。这一研究有助于厘清失业率和产出变化的脉冲响应，并为其他变量的推断提供更可靠的依据，这些变量的表现与搜寻-匹配模型的预测结果一致。研究发现，工资加成冲击对失业率和通货膨胀的总体波动具有显著影响，能够显著传导至价格水平，并对职位空缺率、企业利润以及劳动份额的变动机制提供合理的解释。。

papers.title: Product Design in a Hedonically Differentiated Duopoly
papers.venue: The B E Journal of Theoretical Economics
papers.abstract:
Abstract
                  
                    Using a
                    reduced
                    version of the
                    generalized hedonic linear
                    (GHL) model developed by Pellegrino (2025. “Product Differentiation and Oligopoly: A Network Approach.”
                    The American Economic Review
                    115 (4): 1170–225), we study the strategic design of products in a multidimensional characteristics space. We construct a simple two stage duopoly game in which firms first choose the design of their product and then set their output. We show that at the unique subgame perfect Nash equilibrium both firms choose the unique product design perfectly aligned with the consumer’s ideal bundle of characteristics. We characterize how this outcome emerges through an adjustment dynamics in which product design becomes the key strategic instrument for gaining a competitive advantage in the quantity subgame. We refer to this process as the undercutting mechanism.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要

我们采用了Pellegrino（2025年）在《美国经济评论》（American Economic Review）第115卷第4期（第1170–1225页）中提出的广义享乐线性模型（Generalized Hedonic Linear Model，GHL）的简化版本，研究了在多维特征空间中产品的战略设计问题。我们构建了一个简单的两阶段双寡头博弈模型：企业首先选择产品设计，随后确定产量。研究发现，在唯一的子博弈完美纳什均衡（subgame perfect Nash equilibrium）下，两家企业都会选择与消费者理想特征组合完全匹配的产品设计。我们通过分析产品设计的动态调整过程来解释这一结果的形成机制——在这一过程中，产品设计成为企业在数量竞争（quantity subgame）中获得竞争优势的关键战略工具。我们将这一过程称为“低价竞争机制”（undercutting mechanism）。。研究方法：均衡模型。

papers.title: Sequential Pricing Mechanisms for Surplus Division
papers.abstract: Extending the Price-and-Choose (P&C) mechanism of Echenique and Nunez (2025), we propose the Price-Accept-and-Choose (PA&C) mechanism, which preserves efficiency while eliminating P&C's first-mover advantage. We then analyze randomized and bidding variants and show that the resulting equilibrium payoffs correspond to standard solutions in transferable utility games: the Center of the Imputation Set value for P&C and the Shapley value for PA&C. In the randomized variants, these solutions arise in expectation; in the bidding variants, they are implemented on every equilibrium path. We further relate other efficient designs, such as balanced VCG payments, to additional solution concepts, forging an interpretable bridge between implementation theory and cooperative game theory.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在Echenique和Nunez（2025）提出的“价格选择”（Price-and-Choose, P&C）机制的基础上，我们提出了“价格接受选择”（Price-Accept-and-Choose, PA&C）机制。该机制在保持效率的同时消除了P&C机制中先行者的优势。随后，我们分析了随机化变体和竞价变体，并证明这两种机制下的均衡收益分别对应于可转移效用游戏中的标准解：P&C机制下的“归因集中心值”（Center of the Imputation Set）和PA&C机制下的“Shapley值”。在随机化变体中，这些标准解以期望值的形式出现；而在竞价变体中，这些解会在每条均衡路径上得到实现。此外，我们还将其他高效的设计方案（如平衡的VCG支付机制）与额外的解概念联系起来，从而在实施理论与合作博弈论之间建立起了一个可解释的桥梁。。研究方法：随机实验、均衡模型。

papers.title: Off-policy causal estimation in networks
papers.abstract: In the presence of interference, where the treatment assigned to one unit can affect the outcomes of others, many causal estimands depend on the treatment-assignment policy under which the experiment is conducted. This policy dependence creates a fundamental challenge for off-policy estimation, where the goal is to estimate causal quantities under a hypothetical intervention policy different from the one used to collect data. We study this problem of off-policy estimation of causal effects for heterogeneous Bernoulli policies. By representing exposure-weighted potential outcomes in the biased Fourier basis of the experimental design, we construct, for any prespecified Fourier subspace encoding the assumed interference structure, the unique minimum-$L^2$ weight that transports every function in that subspace. Global and local inverse-probability weights, linear-interference weights, and no-interference weights are special cases. The weight variance is a structured chi-square distance between the experiment and target policies. When the assumed interference structure is misspecified, the introduced bias couples the omitted outcome spectrum with the corresponding policy-shift coefficients, yielding a sharp robustness bound and a bias-variance trade-off. A Fourier-neighborhood-overlap condition gives consistency under structured interference, and we state a Doob-martingale central limit theorem for off-policy estimators. As the variance is not identified, we derive identifiable bounds and associated conservative estimators of the variance. Simulations illustrate these theoretical results for the design and analysis of experiments under network interference and design mismatch.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】在存在干扰的情况下，即一个实验单元所接受的处理方式可能会影响其他单元的结果，许多因果估计量都依赖于实验所采用的分配处理策略。这种策略依赖性为“离策略估计”（off-policy estimation）带来了根本性的挑战——离策略估计的目标是在与收集数据时使用的干预策略不同的假设性干预策略下估计因果效应。我们研究了在异质伯努利（Bernoulli）策略下进行离策略估计的问题。通过将基于实验设计的加权潜在结果表示为有偏傅里叶（biased Fourier）基函数，我们为任何预先指定的傅里叶子空间（该子空间编码了假设的干扰结构）构造了一个唯一的最小$L^2$权重，该权重能够将子空间中的所有函数“传输”出来。全局逆概率权重（global inverse-probability weights）、线性干扰权重（linear-interference weights）以及无干扰权重（no-interference weights）都是这种构造的特殊情况。权重方差实际上表示了实验策略与目标策略之间的结构化卡方（structured chi-square）距离。当假设的干扰结构被错误指定时，引入...。研究方法：数值模拟、实验方法。

papers.title:
When Politics Meets Money: Geopolitical Risk and Money Demand in the
 US
 and Euro Area
papers.abstract: This paper investigates the impact of geopolitical risk on real money demand in the United States and the Euro Area using Divisia monetary aggregates. To account for the potential instability of money demand and the complex nature of geopolitical shocks, we employ a comprehensive empirical framework combining linear and non‐linear autoregressive distributed lag (ARDL) models with a Markov‐switching vector autoregression (MS‐VAR) approach. This framework enables us to capture not only short‐ and long‐run dynamics but also potential asymmetries, non‐linearities and regime‐dependent effects in the relationship between geopolitical risk and money demand. Our findings reveal that the effects of geopolitical risk on real money demand are both non‐linear and asymmetric, with important differences across regions. In the United States, positive geopolitical risk shocks increase money demand in the short run, reflecting heightened precautionary liquidity motives under conditions of uncertainty. However, this effect gradually reverses over time as economic agents rebalance their portfolios towards alternative safe‐haven assets. In contrast, geopolitical risk exerts a persistent negative effect on money demand in the Euro Area, suggesting heterogeneous liquidity preferences and varying risk perceptions across investors. This result may reflect the structural fragmentation and financial heterogeneity that continue to characterise the Euro Area. Furthermore, the Markov‐switching analysis highlights the state‐dependent nature of this relationship, showing that the impact of geopolitical risk on money demand is substantially stronger during periods of heightened volatility and uncertainty. These findings carry important implications for central banks, investors and policymakers by emphasising the role of geopolitical risk as a key determinant of liquidity conditions and monetary stability.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】本文利用Divisia货币总量指标，研究了地缘政治风险对美国和欧元区实际货币需求的影响。为了解释货币需求的潜在不稳定性以及地缘政治冲击的复杂性，我们采用了一个综合性的实证框架，该框架结合了线性与非线性自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型以及马尔可夫转换向量自回归（MS-VAR）方法。这一框架使我们能够捕捉到地缘政治风险与货币需求之间关系中的短期和长期动态变化，以及潜在的不对称性、非线性特征和制度依赖性效应。研究结果表明，地缘政治风险对实际货币需求的影响既具有非线性特征，也表现出明显的地区差异：在美国，正的地缘政治风险冲击在短期内会增加货币需求，这反映了在不确定性环境下人们出于预防性考虑而增加流动性需求；然而，随着时间的推移，这种效应会逐渐减弱，因为经济主体会重新调整其投资组合，转向其他安全资产。相比之下，地缘政治风险对欧元区的货币需求产生了持续的负面影响，这表明投资者之间存在不同的流动性偏好和风险认知。这一结果可能反映了欧元区持续存在的结构性分裂和金融异质性。此外，马尔可夫转换分析进一步强调了这种关系的制度依赖性，即在市场波动性和不确定性较高的时期，地缘政治风险对货币需求的影响更为显著...。研究方法：向量自回归、回归分析。

papers.title: The Impact of Natural Resources, Renewable Energy, and International Trade on Sustainable Economic Growth in APEC
papers.venue: Dinasti International Journal of Economics, Finance & Accounting
papers.abstract: This study analyzes the influence of natural resources, renewable energy consumption, and international trade on sustainable economic growth in 14 APEC member countries during the period 1995–2021. Using the fixed effect model (FEM) panel data regression method, the results show that these three variables have a positive and significant effect on sustainable economic growth. Natural resources provide the largest contribution, followed by renewable energy and international trade. These findings emphasize the importance of integrating sustainable resource management, clean energy transition, and green trade in supporting inclusive and environmentally friendly economic development in the APEC region.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】本研究分析了1995年至2021年间自然资源、可再生能源消费和国际贸易对14个亚太经合组织（APEC）成员国可持续经济增长的影响。通过采用固定效应模型（FEM）的面板数据回归方法，研究结果表明这三个变量对可持续经济增长具有积极且显著的作用。其中，自然资源的贡献最大，其次是可再生能源和国际贸易。这些发现强调了将可持续资源管理、清洁能源转型和绿色贸易相结合对于促进APEC地区包容性和环境友好的经济发展的重要性。。研究方法：面板数据、固定效应、回归分析。

papers.title: Delegated Portfolio Management With Random Default
papers.abstract:
ABSTRACT
                  We consider the problem of optimal portfolio delegation between an investor and a portfolio manager under a random default time. We focus on a novel variation of the Principal‐Agent problem adapted to this framework. We address the challenge of an uncertain investment horizon caused by an exogenous random default time, after which neither the agent nor the principal can access the market. This uncertainty introduces significant complexities in analyzing the problem, requiring distinct mathematical approaches for two cases: when the random default time falls within the initial time frame  and when it extends beyond this period. We develop a theoretical framework to model the stochastic dynamics of the investment process, incorporating the random default time. We then analyze the portfolio manager's investment decisions and compensation mechanisms for both scenarios. In the first case, where the default time could be unbounded, we apply results from Backward Stochastic Differential Equations (BSDEs) and control theory to address the agent's problem. In the second case, where the default time is within the interval , the problem becomes more intricate due to the degeneracy of the BSDE's driver. For both scenarios, we demonstrate that the contracting problem can be resolved by examining the existence of solutions to integro‐partial Hamilton–Jacobi–Bellman (HJB) equations. We develop a deep‐learning algorithm to solve the problem with no access to the optimizer of the Hamiltonian function by means of an actor–critic algorithm.
papers.summary_zh:
【金融经济学】摘要  
我们研究了在随机违约时间背景下，投资者与投资组合管理者之间进行最优投资组合委托的问题。我们重点关注了适用于该框架的委托-代理问题的一个新颖变体。由于存在外生的随机违约时间，导致投资期限具有不确定性，此时代理人和委托人都无法进入市场，这一不确定性为问题分析带来了显著复杂性。我们需要针对两种情况采用不同的数学方法：一种是随机违约时间发生在初始时间范围内，另一种是违约时间超出了该时间段。我们构建了一个理论框架来模拟包含随机违约时间在内的投资过程的随机动态，并进一步分析了投资组合管理者的投资决策及相应的补偿机制。在第一种情况下（即违约时间可能无限延长），我们运用倒向随机微分方程（BSDEs）和控制理论来解决代理人的问题；在第二种情况下（即违约时间在特定区间内），由于BSDE驱动函数的特殊性，问题变得更加复杂。对于这两种情况，我们均通过研究积分-偏微分哈密顿-雅可比-贝尔曼（HJB）方程的解的存在性来解决问题。我们还开发了一种深度学习算法，通过演员-评论家（actor-critic）框架在无需直接访问哈密顿函数优化器的情况下解决该问题。。研究方法：随机过程。

papers.title: Eliciting ESG Preferences for Reinforcement Learning-Based Portfolio Optimization
papers.abstract: Modern portfolio management increasingly demands a balance between traditional risk-adjusted returns and strict Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) mandates. Current Reinforcement Learning (RL) approaches typically optimize for a single ESG provider, neglecting the significant divergence in rating methodologies across the industry and the unintuitive nature of manually weighting conflicting objectives. This paper addresses these limitations by formulating ESG-aware portfolio optimization as a Multi-Objective Reinforcement Learning (MORL) problem that simultaneously incorporates ratings from three distinct ESG agencies. To bridge the gap between high-dimensional algorithmic trade-offs and human decision-making, we integrate a Preference Elicitation framework using Gaussian Processes. This system enables practitioners to infer their latent utility functions through intuitive pairwise comparisons of candidate portfolios based on their Sharpe ratios and aggregate ESG scores. We systematically evaluate our framework by employing Large Language Model (LLM) personas to simulate Portfolio Managers operating under varied regional contexts. Empirical results using historical market data reveal that regional backgrounds fundamentally shift the derived preference weights. For instance, European-based personas tend to prioritize ESG alignment over financial returns, while Texas-based personas favor risk-adjusted performance. This work offers a highly adaptable framework that successfully aligns multi-objective algorithmic trading with diverse, real-world human sustainability preferences.
papers.summary_zh: 【绿色金融与可持续发展】现代投资组合管理日益需要在传统的风险调整回报与严格的环保、社会和治理（ESG）要求之间取得平衡。现有的强化学习（RL）方法通常针对单一的ESG评级机构进行优化，忽略了行业内评级方法存在的显著差异，以及手动权衡相互冲突的目标所带来的非直观性问题。本文通过将ESG因素纳入投资组合优化过程，将其构建为一个多目标强化学习（MORL）问题来解决这些局限性，该问题同时考虑了来自三个不同ESG机构的评级结果。为弥合高维算法决策与人类决策之间的差距，我们采用了基于高斯过程的偏好引导框架，使从业者能够通过直观的成对比较（基于投资组合的夏普比率和综合ESG得分）来推断其潜在的效用函数。我们通过使用大型语言模型（LLM）模拟在不同地区背景下工作的投资组合经理，系统地评估了这一框架的有效性。基于历史市场数据的实证结果表明，地区背景会显著影响投资者所偏好的权重分配：例如，欧洲背景的投资者更倾向于优先考虑ESG合规性而非财务回报，而德克萨斯州的投资者则更看重经风险调整后的投资表现。这项研究提出了一个高度灵活的框架，成功地将多目标算法交易与现实中投资者多样化的可持续性偏好相结合。。研究方法：大语言模型、优化方法。

papers.title: Estimation risk in conditional expectiles
papers.abstract: We establish the consistency and asymptotic normality of a two-step estimator of conditional expectiles in the context of conditional scale models. We first estimate the conditional variance parameters by quasi-maximum likelihood and then compute the unconditional expectile of the innovations using the empirical distribution of the standardized residuals. We show how replacing true innovations with standardized residuals affects the asymptotic variances of both conditional and unconditional expectile estimators. Finally, our empirical analysis reveals that conditional expectiles assess tail risk in cryptomarkets in a more robust manner than traditional quantile-based risk measures, such as value at risk and expected shortfall.
papers.summary_zh: 【风险管理与衍生品】我们在条件尺度模型的背景下，证明了条件期望值的两步估计量具有一致性和渐近正态性。首先，我们通过拟最大似然法估计条件方差参数，然后利用标准化残差的经验分布来计算创新变量的无条件期望值。我们分析了用标准化残差替代真实创新变量对条件期望值估计量和无条件期望值估计量的渐近方差的影响。最后，我们的实证分析表明，条件期望值在评估加密货币市场的尾部风险时，比传统的基于分位数的风险度量方法（如风险价值VaR和预期亏损ES）更为稳健。。研究方法：最大似然估计。

papers.title: Modeling Trade Durations under Temporal Granularity Effects in Forex Markets
papers.abstract: Trade durations in high-frequency foreign exchange data exhibit increased occurrence near integer values. To address this empirical phenomenon, we propose the granularity-adjusted autoregressive conditional duration (GA-ACD) model. It is based on a novel two-component mixture distribution consisting of a standard generalized gamma component for regular durations and a second component that locally redistributes probability mass around integer values to capture heaping. Conditional dynamics are modeled within a score-driven framework, allowing the scale parameter to vary over time in response to past durations, and enabling maximum likelihood estimation of all model parameters. A simulation study shows that ignoring heaping leads to biased parameter estimates and distorted inference regarding both the distribution and the dynamics of durations. An empirical analysis demonstrates that integer-duration clustering is pervasive across major currency pairs and that the GA-ACD model outperforms the standard generalized gamma ACD model.
papers.summary_zh: 【国际贸易】高频外汇数据中的交易持续时间在接近整数值时出现频率更高。为了解释这一实证现象，我们提出了粒度调整的自回归条件持续时间（GA-ACD）模型。该模型基于一种新颖的双组分混合分布，其中第一组分采用标准广义伽马分布来描述常规的持续时间，第二组分则能够在整数值附近重新分配概率质量，从而捕捉到交易持续时间的聚集现象。条件动态过程在得分驱动框架内进行建模，允许尺度参数根据过去的交易持续时间随时间变化，并实现所有模型参数的最大似然估计。仿真研究表明，忽略这种聚集现象会导致参数估计偏差以及关于持续时间分布和动态特性的错误推断。实证分析进一步证实，整数持续时间聚集现象在主要货币对中普遍存在，且GA-ACD模型的表现优于标准广义伽马ACD模型。。研究方法：最大似然估计、数值模拟。

papers.title: Competitive Market Behavior of LLMs
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as economic agents, yet there is little evidence whether LLM agents are suited for participating in market mechanisms designed for humans, and whether these mechanisms deliver desired outcomes when faced with LLM agents. We address this question by replicating seminal economic experiments, replacing human subjects with LLM agents. We place agents in a double auction environment, which is a widely-used market mechanism. We check whether such a market is able to deliver an efficient allocation of resources, thereby testing a novel dimension of alignment of LLM agents -- their compatibility with a fundamental market mechanism. We find that markets populated by LLM agents exhibit slower or no convergence towards market equilibrium, thus providing less efficient allocations than markets populated by humans. We then analyze agents' individual trading decisions and find substantial heterogeneity both across model families and market roles. We also run a lexical analysis of Chain-of-Thought (CoT) traces generated by the agents. We find that the decision to execute a trade rather than continue incrementally adjusting prices is associated with a shift from strategic considerations toward urgency. We publicly release our testing framework, which can be used for future evaluations.
papers.summary_zh:
📌 研究问题：LLM代理是否适合参与为人类设计的市场机制，以及这些机制在面对LLM代理时能否实现预期结果？
🔬 研究方法：通过用LLM代理替换人类受试者，在双拍卖环境中复制具有里程碑意义的经济实验，以测试市场机制的资源分配效率。
📊 核心发现：LLM代理的市场收敛速度较慢或无法收敛，导致资源分配效率低于人类市场；同时发现不同模型家族和市场角色间存在显著异质性，决策逻辑从战略考量转向紧迫感。
💡 应用价值：发布了公开的测试框架，可用于未来对LLM代理经济行为的评估。

papers.title: Uniform Inference and Certified Capacity at a Reflexive Stability Boundary
papers.abstract: This paper develops uniform inference and certified capacity decisions for an estimated financial stability boundary. Conditional risk, temporary cross-impact, and effective risk-bearing capacity are jointly estimated from dependent observations. Conventional pointwise inference is reliable at a separated simple spectral root but can fail near semisimple or defective collisions. Projecting a valid joint confidence region for the underlying inputs avoids this local approximation and yields a three-way regime decision with abstention and a one-sided capacity bound. A verified two-dimensional implementation keeps numerical error from creating a resolved sign. Structural simulations recover the predicted tradeoff between coverage and resolution, while observed-risk stresses distinguish statistical abstention from an insufficient computational budget. The financial conclusions remain conditional on the identification of cross-impact, the normalization of capacity, and stability of the inputs over the action horizon.
papers.summary_zh: 【金融经济学】本文针对估计的金融稳定边界，提出了统一的推断方法和容量决策机制。条件风险、临时性交叉影响以及实际风险承受能力是通过相关观测数据共同估算得出的。传统的逐点推断方法在处理简单的谱根时较为可靠，但在处理半简单或存在缺陷的复杂情况时可能会出现误差。通过构建有效的联合置信区间，可以避免这种局部近似问题，从而得出包含弃权选项的三类决策结果以及单边容量限制。经过验证的二维实现方式能够防止数值误差对最终结果产生负面影响。结构模拟有助于揭示覆盖范围与分辨率之间的权衡关系；而观测到的风险压力则有助于区分因统计方法限制导致的弃权决策与因计算资源不足导致的决策失误。这些金融结论的有效性仍取决于交叉影响的识别准确性、容量指标的标准化程度，以及相关输入在预测时间范围内的稳定性。。研究方法：数值模拟。
